seo.title: WhatsApp chatbot for business | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer customer questions, share products and send order updates on WhatsApp. Your AI agent replies from your business information and hands over to your team when needed.

hero.title: Answer customers on WhatsApp, day and night.
hero.body: Reply to questions, share products and send order updates where your customers already message you. Steps AI connects your WhatsApp Business number to an AI agent that knows your business.
hero.reassurance: Official WhatsApp Business API. Answers from your information. Your team can step in.

jobs.title: What your agent does on WhatsApp.
jobs.intro: The same agent can answer a question, help someone choose and keep them updated after they buy.

items.title: Answer questions from your information
items.body: Your agent replies using your website, documents and FAQs, so customers get an answer without waiting for opening hours.

items.title: Share products and a checkout link
items.body: Send product cards from your catalogue, add items to a cart and share a checkout link in the chat.

items.title: Send order updates
items.body: With Shopify and a supported delivery tool connected, your agent can tell customers where their order is.

items.title: Hand over to your team
items.body: When a customer needs a person, the conversation moves to your shared inbox with everything said so far.

triggers.title: Start more conversations on WhatsApp.
triggers.intro: Give customers an easy way in, then let your agent take it from there.

items.title: Reply to missed calls on WhatsApp
items.body: When you miss a call, send the caller a WhatsApp message so the conversation can continue in the chat.

items.title: Offer starter questions
items.body: Show a few common questions when someone opens the chat, such as delivery times or opening hours, so they can start with one tap.

items.title: Follow up click-to-WhatsApp ads
items.body: When someone taps a click-to-WhatsApp ad, your agent picks up the conversation and guides them through the next steps.

items.title: Continue from a broadcast
items.body: Replies to your WhatsApp campaigns go to your agent, so every interested customer gets a timely answer.

setup.title: Get set up in three steps.
setup.intro: No code is needed. You can test your agent before customers see it.

items.title: Connect through Meta
items.body: Connect your WhatsApp Business number using the official API. The same Meta connection also covers Instagram and Messenger.

items.title: Add your business information
items.body: Point your agent at your website pages, documents and FAQs, and connect tools such as Shopify or a delivery partner.

items.title: Test it, then switch it on
items.body: Try a few questions yourself, adjust the answers, and turn the agent on when you are happy with it.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: How many conversations you can start each day follows WhatsApp's messaging tiers for your number.
Messages that start a conversation use templates, and Meta must approve each template first.
Order updates need Shopify and one of the supported delivery tools: Shiprocket, Delhivery, DTDC, iThink Logistics or WareIQ.

items.q: Do I need the WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: Yes. Steps AI connects to your WhatsApp Business number through the official API, which you set up through Meta during onboarding.

items.q: What happens when the agent cannot answer?
items.a: It hands the conversation to your team. The customer stays in the same chat, and your team sees the full conversation in the shared inbox.
Your agent shares a checkout link from your store. Customers complete payment on your checkout page.

items.q: Does it work with Instagram and Messenger too?
items.a: Yes. One Meta connection covers WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger, and the same agent can answer on all three.

items.label: Instagram chatbot
items.body: Reply to direct messages and turn comments into conversations.

items.label: Messenger chatbot
items.body: Answer customers who message your Facebook page.

items.label: Website chatbot
items.body: Welcome visitors on your website and help them take the next step.

cta.title: See your agent answer on WhatsApp.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will show you a WhatsApp conversation built around your own products and questions.
